TitleJP: 遺された未来のためのエクレシア
TitleEN: Ecclesia for Those Who Don't Disappear
TitleTH: เอคลีเซีย แด่เรื่องราวที่ไม่เคยเลือนหาย
DescJP: 先生に見送られ、アリウスの生徒たちはそれぞれの想いを胸に試験に臨む。結果はともあれ、試験の後は打ち上げで健闘を讃えあった。後日、アツコはスバルとマイアに、スクワッドが臨時生徒会としてアリウスの再建を担うことを宣言する。スバルも風紀委員として協力することを決意し、アリウスは新たな一歩を踏み出していくのだった。
DescKR: 무사히 시험이 종료되고, 아리우스 스쿼드와 스바루, 마이아는 아리우스의 내일을 위해 각자의 마음을 다진다.
DescEN: The exam ends without issue. The Arius Squad, Subaru, and Maia decide on the fate of Arius.
DescTH: หลังช่วงเวลาสอบผ่านพ้นไป สควอดของอาเรียส สุบารุ และไมอาต่างก็ตัดสินใจเกี่ยวกับอนาคตของอาเรียส
DescTW: 考試順利結束，奧利斯小隊、昴與舞彩，各自下定決心，為奧利斯的明日努力。

DialogJP.Text: 第10話;遺された未来のためのエクレシア
[log]総合試験当日[/log]

DialogJP.Name: アリウスの生徒たち
DialogJP.Text: ……どう？

DialogJP.Name: アリウスの生徒A
DialogJP.Text: うん。

DialogJP.Name: アリウスの生徒A
DialogJP.Text: 分かんないけどさ。

DialogJP.Name: アリウスの生徒A
DialogJP.Text: すっごい自信あるんだよね。

DialogJP.Name: アリウスの生徒A
DialogJP.Text: まぁ、根拠は無いんだけど。

DialogJP.Name: アリウスの生徒B
DialogJP.Text: それってつまり、全然勉強してないってことじゃん……。

DialogJP.Name: アリウスの生徒C
DialogJP.Text: でもさ。

DialogJP.Name: アリウスの生徒D
DialogJP.Text: ん？

DialogJP.Name: アリウスの生徒C
DialogJP.Text: 教科書って、勉強のための本でしょ？

DialogJP.Name: アリウスの生徒D
DialogJP.Text: そうだね。

DialogJP.Name: アリウスの生徒C
DialogJP.Text: ってことは、私たちの教科書は失敗作なんだよ。

DialogJP.Name: アリウスの生徒C
DialogJP.Text: だって、私を教えるのに失敗してるからさ。

DialogJP.Name: アリウスの生徒D
DialogJP.Text: わぁ、斬新な発想……。

DialogJP.Name: アリウスの生徒D
DialogJP.Text: とにかく、試験頑張ろうね……。

DialogJP.Name: アリウスの生徒C
DialogJP.Text: そっちもね……。

DialogJP.Name: アリウスの生徒C
DialogJP.Text: ……みんながケアレスミスしますように。

DialogJP.Name: アリウスの生徒D
DialogJP.Text: お互いに頑張るんじゃなかったの……？
[ns] "みんな！ちゃんと勉強してきたかな？"

DialogJP.Name: アリウスの生徒A
DialogJP.Text: あ、先生！

DialogJP.Name: アリウスの生徒B
DialogJP.Text: 先生……。

DialogJP.Name: アリウスの生徒B
DialogJP.Text: どう考えても赤点取りそうな時って……どうしたらいいですか……？
[s1] "心配しなくても大丈夫。"
[s2] "やってみなきゃ分からないよ。"
[s3] "だって、結果が出るまでは赤点じゃないからね。"

DialogJP.Name: アリウスの生徒C
DialogJP.Text: わあ……すっごい励まされる一言だ……。
[s] "とにかく、みんな頑張ってね！"

DialogJP.Name: アリウスの生徒D
DialogJP.Text: はい……。

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: 先生、おはよう。もしかして、見送りに来てくれたの？

DialogJP.Name: ミサキ
DialogJP.Text: 心配しなくても、試験はちゃんと受けるよ。これまでの苦労がもったいないし。

DialogJP.Name: サオリ
DialogJP.Text: ん？先生は応援しに来てくれたんだと思ったが……。

DialogJP.Name: ヒヨリ
DialogJP.Text:
あ……。み、ミサキさんも、それは分かってて……
あ、あえてそう言ったんじゃ……。

DialogJP.Name: サオリ
DialogJP.Text: そうだったのか？すまない、気づけなくて……。

DialogJP.Name: ミサキ
DialogJP.Text: いや、そうじゃなくて……！

DialogJP.Name: ミサキ
DialogJP.Text: はあ……もういいよ。

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: それじゃあ、行ってきます。

DialogJP.Name: ヒヨリ
DialogJP.Text: が、頑張ってきますね……。

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: おはようございます、先生。

DialogJP.Name: マイア
DialogJP.Text:
お、おはようございます……。
……あれ？今日はお休み……なんですか？
[s4] "今日はここで仕事があるんだ。"
[s5] "みんなの応援っていう仕事がね。"

DialogJP.Name: マイア
DialogJP.Text: そ、そうなんですね……。

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: ……先生、なんですか？私のことをじっと見て。

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: はい？試験を受けることに抵抗があるか、ですか……。

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: ……正直、ないとは言えません。

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: でも……信じてみることにしました。

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: もう一度やってみようと声を上げた、[ruby=あの子たち]アリウス[/ruby]の声を。

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: ……そして、先生を。
[s] "……ありがとう。"

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: な、なんですか急に！？
[s] "私を信じてくれて、ありがとう。"

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: そ、れは……。

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: え？先生だって、生徒に信じてもらえなきゃ、実は不安になってブレることもある……？

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: それはちょっと……想定外の答えですね……。

DialogJP.Name: マイア
DialogJP.Text: それじゃ私も、先生の役に立ててますか！？
[s] "もちろん。マイアも、ありがとう。"
（マイアの頭を撫でた）

DialogJP.Name: マイア
DialogJP.Text: えへへ……。なんか……嬉しいです……。ありがとうございます、先生。

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: 私も――

DialogJP.Name: マイア
DialogJP.Text: あ、先輩！もう時間みたいです！急ぎましょう！

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: えっ、あ、あぁ……。

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: はい、行きましょう……。
[ns] "そろそろ……トリニティの方も、試験が始まってる頃かな……。"
（大人でよかったと思えることが一つあるとすれば）
（試験を受けなくていいということかもしれない。なんてことを考えながら）
（近くのカフェで仕事をして、試験が終わるのを待つことにした）

DialogJP.Name: アリウスの生徒A
DialogJP.Text: あぁ……これで終わりなんだね……。

DialogJP.Name: アリウスの生徒B
DialogJP.Text: どうだった？

DialogJP.Name: アリウスの生徒D
DialogJP.Text: ……全滅。

DialogJP.Name: アリウスの生徒A
DialogJP.Text: まだ自己採点もしてないのに！？

DialogJP.Name: アリウスの生徒D
DialogJP.Text: なんていうか……感覚ってあるじゃん。

DialogJP.Name: アリウスの生徒B
DialogJP.Text: まぁ……実は、私もそんな感じなんだけど……。

DialogJP.Name: アリウスの生徒D
DialogJP.Text: 心の友よ……。
[ns] "みんな、おかえり！"

DialogJP.Name: アリウスの生徒A
DialogJP.Text: 先生……。

DialogJP.Name: アリウスの生徒B
DialogJP.Text: うぅ……。

DialogJP.Name: アリウスの生徒C
DialogJP.Text: 試験……ダメでしたぁぁぁぁ！
[s6] "言ったでしょ？結果が出るまでは赤点じゃないって。"
[s7] "だから今は、試験が終わった後の伝統行事をやりに行こう！"

DialogJP.Name: アリウスの生徒D
DialogJP.Text: 試験が終わった後の……伝統行事？

DialogJP.Name: アリウスの生徒A
DialogJP.Text: 何ですか、それ？
[s8] "それはね……「テストの打ち上げ」だよ！"
[s9] "美味しいものを食べて、思いっきり遊ぶ！"
[s10] "絶対に守り抜くべき、伝統なんだ！"

DialogJP.Name: アリウスの生徒B
DialogJP.Text: そんな素敵な伝統があったなんて……！

DialogJP.Name: アリウスの生徒C
DialogJP.Text: 試験も、意外と悪くないかもしれませんね！

DialogJP.Name: アリウスの生徒D
DialogJP.Text:
いや、それはちょっと考え直したほうが……
準備、あんなに大変だったじゃん……。

DialogJP.Name: アリウスの生徒A
DialogJP.Text:
でもそれはもう終わったこと！
つまり――！

DialogJP.Name: アリウスの生徒A
DialogJP.Text: 喉元過ぎれば熱さ忘れる！

DialogJP.Name: アリウスの生徒D
DialogJP.Text: これこそアリウス流だね！

DialogJP.Name: アリウスの生徒B
DialogJP.Text: だね！

DialogJP.Name: アリウスの生徒B
DialogJP.Text: 先生！たくさん食べても……いいですか？
[s11] "もちろん！"
[s12] "じゃあ、他の子たちも呼んでおいで！"

DialogJP.Name: アリウスの生徒たち
DialogJP.Text: はい！
（こうして、アリウスの子たちにとって初めての試験は）
（派手な打ち上げで、幕を閉じたのだった……）

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: こんにちは、スバル。マイアも、どうぞ座って。

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: こんにちは、アツコさん。

DialogJP.Name: マイア
DialogJP.Text: あ、こ、こんにちは……アツコ、姫様……。

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: ふふっ。もっと気軽に呼んでくれていいのに。

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: そう決めたでしょ？二人で。

DialogJP.Name: マイア
DialogJP.Text: そ、そうは言っても……！でも、でも……うぅ……。

DialogJP.Name: マイア
DialogJP.Text: あ……アツコ、さん……。

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: うん。ありがとう。

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: それで……今日は、どういうご用件ですか？

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: 「外」では普通、試験が終わったらこうするって聞いたから。

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: さ、まずは食べよう？このカフェ、ペカンパイが有名なんだって。

DialogJP.Name: マイア
DialogJP.Text: は、はい……いただきます……。

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: ふふっ、後はね、こうやってお茶をしながら、試験の感想を言い合うらしいんだけど……二人はどうだった？

DialogJP.Name: マイア
DialogJP.Text: 分かるところは全部書きました！

DialogJP.Name: マイア
DialogJP.Text: 分からないことの方が多かったですけど……。

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: スバルは？

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: これが3年生なのか、と。少しギャップを感じましたね。

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: ふふ。でも、自分の実力を知るための模試だからね。

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: ペナルティとか処分もないし、気楽に結果を受け止めればいいと思うよ。

DialogJP.Name: マイア
DialogJP.Text: えっ？ほ、本当の試験だと処分とかあるんですか！？

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: 結果が悪かったら補習が入ったり――

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: ずっと成績が低いと……留年とか、卒業できなくなることもあるみたい。

DialogJP.Name: マイア
DialogJP.Text: あ……処分って、そういう……。

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: ……うん。

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: ある意味、優しい世界とも言えるかな。

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: これから……スクワッドはどうするんですか？

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: やっぱり気になるよね。まぁ、当然かな。

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: アリウスへの責任を取ろうと思ってるよ。

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: ……具体的には？

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: アリウスにも生徒会ができるまで、私たちは臨時生徒会の役割を担いたいと思ってる。

DialogJP.Name: マイア
DialogJP.Text: スクワッドが……生徒会に？じゃ、じゃあ――！

DialogJP.Name: マイア
DialogJP.Text: 私たちの学園も……やっと……ちゃんとした学園に戻れるんですか！？

DialogJP.Name: マイア
DialogJP.Text: 何百年ぶりに！？

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: そうなれるように、精一杯頑張るよ。

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: ――アリウスの臨時生徒会長として。

DialogJP.Name: マイア
DialogJP.Text: 生徒会長！？

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: マイア、声が大きいですよ。

DialogJP.Name: マイア
DialogJP.Text: あ、す、すみません……。

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: ……実際、アリウスの伝統に則れば、その役目はあなたを置いて他にいません。

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: それで、他のメンバーは？

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: 多分、ミサキが会計をやることになると思う。

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: 「なんで私が……はぁ、やればいいんでしょ……」って本人は言ってたけど。

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: 言い換えれば、「やるからには、ちゃんと頑張る」って意味だから。

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: そうなんですか……？

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text:
ミサキは素直じゃないからね。
あ、これ本人に言うとすっごく怒るから、内緒にしてね。

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: ……はぁ。

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: あとは……サッちゃんが総務兼副会長。

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: 妥当ですね。

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: 学校の運営方針で、こういう提案も出してたよ。 「みんなできるだけアルバイトをしよう」って。

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: なんでまた……？

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text:
社会のことを学べるし、お小遣いも稼げる。
それがアリウスの復興にもつながる、って言ってたかな。

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: みんなが慣れるまでは、契約書は全部目を通させろ、とも言ってたね。

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: ……自分の経験を押し付けてるだけじゃないですか。

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text:
ほら、人は経験から学ぶ生き物だから。
でも、それ以外の提案もあったんだ。

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: というと？

DialogJP.Name: サオリ
DialogJP.Text: これで、おおよその方向性は見えてきたな。

DialogJP.Name: サオリ
DialogJP.Text:
部活動設立の申請については、予算と妥当性を勘案して
許可する必要はあるが……。

DialogJP.Name: サオリ
DialogJP.Text: それは実際の状況を見ながら進めればいいだろう。

DialogJP.Name: サオリ
DialogJP.Text: ……ん？アツコ、もっと個人的な希望を聞きたい……とはどういう意味だ？

DialogJP.Name: サオリ
DialogJP.Text: 私たちは今、学園のことについて話をしているはずだ。

DialogJP.Name: サオリ
DialogJP.Text: 生徒会長としてのお願い……？

DialogJP.Name: サオリ
DialogJP.Text:
そういうことなら……。
いや、これは聞き流してもらって構わないのだが……。

DialogJP.Name: サオリ
DialogJP.Text: 制服を……作ってもいいんじゃないか……と。

DialogJP.Name: サオリ
DialogJP.Text: 可愛くて、お洒落だったら……いいなって……。

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: ありがとう、サッちゃん。そういうのを聞きたかったんだ。

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: ごめん、これはもう少し整理してから話すね。

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: え？あ……そうですか。

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: えっと、それで……あとはヒヨリだね。

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: ヒヨリは……。

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: ……書記？

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: まさに、記録係としての書記でしょうね。それは……。

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: うん……本人もそれを自覚してたのか、最初は「うわあぁぁん」って泣いちゃってさ。

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: でもすぐに気を取り直して、本気で頑張るってやる気を見せてくれて。

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: ヒヨリがやる気出すのはいいことだから、私も嬉しかったな。

DialogJP.Name: マイア
DialogJP.Text: わ、私にはよく分かりませんけど……でも、いいですね……ヒヨリさん、優しいですし……。

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: そうですね……まあ、あなたがそう思うなら……。

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: それでね、「ニコメディアトゥループ」にもお願いしたいことがあるの。

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: ……私たちに？

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: 風紀委員としての役割を引き受けてもらえないかな。

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: 風紀……委員、ですか……？

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: うん。学園の治安や風紀を守るお仕事だね。

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: これは、スバルじゃなきゃ頼めないと思うんだ。

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: ……もし私が断ったら？

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: 断るの？

DialogJP.Name: マイア
DialogJP.Text: せ、先輩……？

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: ……はぁ。

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: そういう言い方はどうかと思いますよ。

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: そうかな？でも、臨時とはいえ生徒会長だし。

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: はぁ、構いませんよ。

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: （なんだかんだ人がついて行くのは……才能ですね）

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: で、最終的にはどうするつもりですか？

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: アリウスを素敵な学園にしたい。

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: ……その点は、意見が一致しているようですね。

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: アリウスに残った生徒なら、みんな似たような気持ちなんじゃないかな。

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text:
……それはそうかもしれません。
ただ……実現するためには、やるべきことが山積みでは？

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text:
分かってる。だからこそ、今度は責任を放棄したくないの。
……この話、前にもしたよね。

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: 自信はあるんですか？

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text:
全然。私1人じゃ、できないと思うんだ。
だから、手を貸してほしいの。

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: 手を取り合って、みんなで転ぶことになったら……？

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: 逆に、転んだ誰かを起こしてあげられるかもしれない。

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: どうせ未来は分からないし、悪い方にばかり考えたくないんだ。

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: それこそ、根拠のない楽観主義では？

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: でも、[ruby=・]動[/ruby][ruby=・]く[/ruby][ruby=・]こ[/ruby][ruby=・]と[/ruby]に意味があるんじゃないかな。

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: 私は、それが一番大事だと思ってる。

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: そのためには、未来への漠然とした希望が必要でしょ？

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: みんなと一緒に、前へ進みたいんだ。

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: ……分かりました。

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: 私も、最大限協力しましょう。

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: 何が起こるか、何が待っているかなんて、私たちには分かりませんから。

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: ……試験を受けることになるとすら、思いもしませんでしたし。

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: ふふっ。私もびっくりだったな。

DialogJP.Name: マイア
DialogJP.Text: そ、そういえば……トリニティの団長さん、ですけど……。

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: ミネさん？そっか、その話もしないとだね。

DialogJP.Name: マイア
DialogJP.Text: き、聞いた話だと、あの日からずっと意識が無かったって……。

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: うん、そうだったみたい。

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: でも心配しないで。もう完全に回復したって。

DialogJP.Name: マイア
DialogJP.Text: ほ、本当ですか！？よかった……！

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: しかも、その間は試験勉強できてなかったのに、大きな影響は無いらしいよ。

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: そうですか……それは何よりですね。

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: すごいよね。「黙示録の天使」4人分の力を、自分の中に封じ込めてるようなものだったのに。

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: はい！？

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: ミネさんは4人の天使を倒して、自分も気を失ったでしょ？

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: そのおかげで、7人の天使が全て調和して力を解放する――なんてことにはならずに済んだの。

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: じゃあ……天使を4人も抱えたまま耐えてたってことですか！？

DialogJP.Name: マイア
DialogJP.Text: す、スバル先輩……？

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: あ、すみません。取り乱しました……。

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: スバルが最後の天使として撃退されたとき、ほぼ同時にミネさんも目を覚ましたみたい。

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: そんな、まさか……。1人分でも意識を持ってかれかけたのに……ミネさんの精神力はどうなってるんですか……？

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: ……それが、信念とか、実直さなんじゃないかな？

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: どんな状況でも、どんな苦しみがあっても。

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: それでも、耐えて進んでいく姿。

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: それって……本当にすごいことだと思う。

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: そうですね……。

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: ただ……1つ理解できないことがあるんです。

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: 何？

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: 人を救うと言いながら、なぜ人をボロボロにするんですか、あの方は。

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: アツコさん……？

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text:
なぜいきなり仮面を……？
それだと喋りにくいと言ってませんでしたか？

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: （スッ、ススッ……）

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: 私たち、手話は分かりませんからね！？

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: なっ、逃げるんですか！？

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: あ……でも、会計は済ませてあるんですね……。

DialogJP.Name: マイア
DialogJP.Text: 先輩！私、1つ学びました！

DialogJP.Name: マイア
DialogJP.Text: いざという時のために逃げ道を作っておくのって、すごく大切なんですね！

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: こんなことから学ばなくていいです……。

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: そもそも、そんな状況にならないようにするのが一番です……。

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: あ、先生。いらっしゃい。
[s13] "みんな元気そうだね！"
[s14] "復旧作業は順調？"

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: 今のところは、まだこの場所だけだよ。

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: でも、ここは出発点だから。

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: これからアリウスを、少しずつ変えていきたいんだ。

DialogJP.Name: ミサキ
DialogJP.Text: ……校舎がちゃんとしてないと、通う気にもならないし。

DialogJP.Name: ミサキ
DialogJP.Text: そのうち、新入生とか転校生も受け入れることになるのかな。

DialogJP.Name: ヒヨリ
DialogJP.Text: で、でも……アリウスに通いたい人なんて、いるんでしょうか……。

DialogJP.Name: サオリ
DialogJP.Text: それが、意外といるみたいなんだ。

DialogJP.Name: サオリ
DialogJP.Text: アリウスならではの……あまり口に出しにくい技術を学びたいって人が……。

DialogJP.Name: ヒヨリ
DialogJP.Text: で、できれば無くなったほうがいい技術なんじゃ……！？

DialogJP.Name: サオリ
DialogJP.Text: 力に憧れる人間は、いつの時代も、どこにでもいるからな……。

DialogJP.Name: ミサキ
DialogJP.Text: 実態を知ったら、どうせすぐ逃げるんだし。心配ないでしょ。
[s] "そ、そういえば、みんな試験はどうだった？"

DialogJP.Name: アツコ
DialogJP.Text: 私は平均して90点くらいだったよ。初めてにしては、悪くなかったかも？

DialogJP.Name: ミサキ
DialogJP.Text: ……赤点が何個か。

DialogJP.Name: ミサキ
DialogJP.Text: 国語……作者の意見とか聞かれても分かんないんだけど。

DialogJP.Name: ヒヨリ
DialogJP.Text: 私は赤点ギリギリでした……。うわぁぁぁん。
[s15] "いやいや、すごいと思うよ！"
[s16] "赤点を回避しただけでも立派だよ！"

DialogJP.Name: ヒヨリ
DialogJP.Text:
うわぁぁぁん～！
その優しさがかえって胸に刺さりますぅ……。
[s] "次はもっと頑張ればいいだけだよ！"

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: 巡回報告に戻りました……あ、先生。いらしてたんですか。

DialogJP.Name: マイア
DialogJP.Text: あっ、こんにちは。アリウスへ……ようこそ！

DialogJP.Name: マイア
DialogJP.Text: そ、それで……ご用件は何でしょう？

DialogJP.Name: マイア
DialogJP.Text: ……え？試験の結果を聞きに……？

DialogJP.Name: マイア
DialogJP.Text:
ごめんなさい、先生……私、赤点ギリギリの点数しか取れませんでした……。
うわあああん～

DialogJP.Name: ヒヨリ
DialogJP.Text: え？ま、マイアさんもですか？

DialogJP.Name: マイア
DialogJP.Text: ひ、ヒヨリさんも？

DialogJP.Name: ヒヨリ
DialogJP.Text: わ、私たち……赤点回避仲間ですね……！

DialogJP.Name: マイア
DialogJP.Text: ですね……！

DialogJP.Name: ヒヨリ
DialogJP.Text: 次は、もっと頑張りましょうね……！

DialogJP.Name: マイア
DialogJP.Text: はい……！

DialogJP.Name: ヒヨリ&マイア
DialogJP.Text: うわぁぁぁん～！
[ns] "スバルはどうだった？"
[s] "他のみんなは教えてくれたよ？"

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: 先生、実はすでに知ってるんですよね？
[ns] "平均点くらいだったんだってね。"

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: ……はい。
[s] "よく頑張ったね。"

DialogJP.Name: スバル
DialogJP.Text: ……頑張ったと言えるのでしょうか。
[wa:1850]― [log=스바루]……本当に、[wa:2000]色々なことが[wa:700]ありましたね。[/log]
[wa:600]― [log=스바루]今振り返ると、[/log]
― [log=스바루]全てが夢だったんじゃないかと[wa:1100]思うほどですが……。[/log]
[wa:250]― [log=스바루]でも、[wa:1600]すべてのことに[/log]
― [log=스바루]改めて感謝の気持ちを[wa:1050]伝えたいと思っています。[/log]
[wa:350]― [log=스바루]――これだけは、[wa:1900]私の本心です。[/log]

DialogJP.Name: サオリ
DialogJP.Text: ん？私の成績か？

DialogJP.Name: サオリ
DialogJP.Text: うーん……。

DialogJP.Name: サオリ
DialogJP.Text: ちょっと……自慢っぽく聞こえたら悪いが……。

DialogJP.Name: サオリ
DialogJP.Text: そうだな、これも全部先生のおかげだ。

DialogJP.Name: サオリ
DialogJP.Text: 満点……だった。

DialogJP.Name: サオリ
DialogJP.Text: ありがとう、先生。

DialogJP.Name: サオリ
DialogJP.Text: 先生は本当に……私の人生の、恩人だ。

DialogKR.Name: 아리우스 학생 A
DialogKR.Text: 왠지 다 잘될 것 같은 자신감이 솟구쳐 오르는군.

DialogKR.Name: 아리우스 학생 C
DialogKR.Text: 교과서라는 건 학생을 잘 가르치기 위해 만들어진 책이잖아?

DialogKR.Name: 아리우스 학생 C
DialogKR.Text: 그렇지만 내가 보기에 우리의 교과서는 실패했어.

DialogKR.Name: 아리우스 학생 B
DialogKR.Text: 어떻게 생각해도 시험을 망칠 것 같은 학생은, 어떻게 해야 할까요…….
[s2] "교실에 들어가서 책상에 앉으면, 그때부터 진짜 시작이라고!"
[s3] "왜냐하면 그때는, 알고 있었던 것도 미묘하게 기억 안 나거든!"

DialogKR.Name: 아츠코
DialogKR.Text: 안녕. 선생님. 좋은 아침이야. 직접 나와 준 거야?

DialogKR.Name: 미사키
DialogKR.Text: ……걱정도 팔자라니까……. 그렇게까지 안 해도 도망 안 쳐. 그동안 고생한 게 아까워서라도 말이지.

DialogKR.Name: 사오리
DialogKR.Text: 음? 나는 선생이 순수하게 응원하자는 마음으로 와 준 것이라고 생각했다만……?

DialogKR.Name: 히요리
DialogKR.Text: 어……. 저는, 미사키 씨도 다 알고 있으면서, 일부러 그렇게 표현한 것이라고 생각해요오…….

DialogKR.Name: 마이아
DialogKR.Text: 아, 안녕하세요. 선생님……. 오늘은 출근 안 하시나요?

DialogKR.Name: 스바루
DialogKR.Text: 아직도 아리우스 모의고사를 보는 것에, 저항감이 느껴지냐고요?

DialogKR.Name: 스바루
DialogKR.Text: 다시 해 보자고 한 우리 [ruby=아리우스]아이들[/ruby]의 목소리와.

DialogKR.Name: 스바루
DialogKR.Text: 네, 네? 가, 갑자기 왜 그러세요?!

DialogKR.Name: 스바루
DialogKR.Text: 네? 선생님도 학생이 믿어 주지 않으면, 사실은 불안하고 흔들릴 수밖에 없다고요?

DialogKR.Name: 스바루
DialogKR.Text: 그건, 조금, 생각 못 한 대답이네요…….

DialogKR.Name: 마이아
DialogKR.Text: 그러면 저도, 선생님께 도움이 되고 있는 건가요?!

DialogKR.Name: 마이아
DialogKR.Text: 헤헤……. 에헤헤……. 기분 좋네요……. 감사합니다. 선생님.

DialogKR.Name: 마이아
DialogKR.Text: 아, 선배! 시간이 됐나 봐요! 어서 가요!
(모의고사를 안 봐도 되는 것이 아닐까, 같은 실없는 생각을 하며.)
(근처 카페에 자리를 잡고, 원격으로 업무를 처리하며, 시험이 끝나는 시간을 기다리기로 했다.)

DialogKR.Name: 아리우스 학생 A
DialogKR.Text: 아, 아직 우리 채점도 안 해 봤잖아!
[s7] "시험 끝난 날에, 꼭 지켜야 하는 전통을 지키러 가야지!"

DialogKR.Name: 아리우스 학생 D
DialogKR.Text: 아니, 그건 조금 다시 생각해 보자……. 준비하는 게 그렇게 힘들었는데……?

DialogKR.Name: 아리우스 학생 A
DialogKR.Text: 끝난 고통은, 더 이상 고통이 아닌 것이다!
[s12] "……그래도 선생님 지갑이 아프니까, 아주 조금만 생각해 주고……."

DialogKR.Name: 아츠코
DialogKR.Text: 안녕, 스바루. 그리고 마이아도. 어서 앉아.

DialogKR.Name: 아츠코
DialogKR.Text: 후훗. 그렇지만 나는 더 이상 공주도 무엇도 아니니까, 그냥 편하게 불러 줘.

DialogKR.Name: 마이아
DialogKR.Text: 그, 그렇게 말하기는 했지만요! 그렇지만, 그렇지만……. 우우…….

DialogKR.Name: 아츠코
DialogKR.Text: 으음~ 시험도 잘 끝났잖아? 그러니까, '바깥'에서는 보통, 이렇게 한다고 들어서.

DialogKR.Name: 아츠코
DialogKR.Text: 자. 우선 먹자. 이 카페, 피칸 파이가 특히 유명하대.

DialogKR.Name: 아츠코
DialogKR.Text: 그래서, 둘 다 다 시험은 잘 봤어? 나는 아는 부분은 전부 후회 없이 풀었다는 느낌이었어.

DialogKR.Name: 마이아
DialogKR.Text: 아는 것보다 모르는 게 더 많았다는 문제가 있었지만요…….

DialogKR.Name: 스바루
DialogKR.Text: ……처음으로 모의고사를 푸는데, 3학년 문제는 조금 버거운 감이 있었어요……. 그 정도만 말해 두겠습니다.

DialogKR.Name: 아츠코
DialogKR.Text: 후후. 그렇지만 모의고사니까. 어디까지나 자신의 실력을 알아보는 척도 같은 거잖아?

DialogKR.Name: 아츠코
DialogKR.Text: 별다른 페널티나 처분 같은 것도 없으니, 마음 편하게 결과를 받아 보면 될 거야.

DialogKR.Name: 마이아
DialogKR.Text: 네……? 진짜 시험은 처분 같은 것도 있나요?!

DialogKR.Name: 아츠코
DialogKR.Text: 음……. 결과가 너무 안 좋으면 보충수업을 실시하기도 하고.

DialogKR.Name: 아츠코
DialogKR.Text: 내내 성적이 안 좋으면……. 유급을 당하거나, 졸업을 못 하게 되는 경우도 있다고 해.

DialogKR.Name: 마이아
DialogKR.Text: 아……. 그런 걸 처분이라고 하는군요. 네…….

DialogKR.Name: 스바루
DialogKR.Text: 이제부터 스쿼드는 어떻게 할 생각인가요, 아츠코 씨?

DialogKR.Name: 아츠코
DialogKR.Text: 역시 그 부분을 묻는구나. 응. 그게 당연하겠지.

DialogKR.Name: 아츠코
DialogKR.Text: 아리우스 스쿼드는, 결과적으로 쭉 방기하고 있던 거나 다름없었던, 아리우스에 대한 책임을 지려고 합니다.

DialogKR.Name: 아츠코
DialogKR.Text: 아리우스 스쿼드는, 다음 아리우스의 학생회가 선출되고 결정될 때까지, 임시 학생회로서 기능하고자 합니다.

DialogKR.Name: 마이아
DialogKR.Text: 아리우스 스쿼드가…… 아리우스 학생회로요? 그럼, 그럼…….

DialogKR.Name: 마이아
DialogKR.Text: 정상화가 될 수 있는 건가요?! 수백 년 만에!?

DialogKR.Name: 아츠코
DialogKR.Text: 그렇게 될 수 있도록, 최선을 다해 볼게.

DialogKR.Name: 스바루
DialogKR.Text: 자, 자. 목소리가 조금 커요. 마이아.

DialogKR.Name: 스바루
DialogKR.Text: ……사실, 아리우스의 얼마 안 되는 남겨진 전통대로라면, 당신 이외에 그 자리를 맡을 수 있는 사람이 없기도 하죠.

DialogKR.Name: 아츠코
DialogKR.Text: 아마도 미사키가 회계 일을 하게 될 거야.

DialogKR.Name: 아츠코
DialogKR.Text: 본인은 '……정말이지 끝까지 굴려 먹네. 알았어. 하면 되잖아, 하면…….'이라고 말했어.

DialogKR.Name: 아츠코
DialogKR.Text: 미사키어로 그건, '이왕 하게 되었으니 최선을 다할게.'라는 의미야.

DialogKR.Name: 아츠코
DialogKR.Text: 으음~ 대충, 말하는 것을 절반 정도만 반대로 해석하면 되는 언어, 라고 할까? 본인에게 말하면 엄청나게 화를 내니까, 조심해 줘.

DialogKR.Name: 아츠코
DialogKR.Text: 학교 운영 방침으로 다음과 같은 권고를 제안했는데, '모두 최대한 많은 아르바이트를 하자.'라고 하더라.

DialogKR.Name: 아츠코
DialogKR.Text: 으음~ 사회의 많은 부분을 빠르게 배울 수 있고, 용돈도 벌 수 있으며, 아리우스를 부흥시키는 데 여러모로 도움이 될 테니까. 라고 하던데?

DialogKR.Name: 아츠코
DialogKR.Text: 아, 계약서 사기에는 주의해야 하니까, 당분간 계약서를 작성하면 자기에게 보여 달라고 했어. 그런 부분은 부끄럽지만 이골이 났다면서.

DialogKR.Name: 스바루
DialogKR.Text: ……그냥 자기가 경험한 거 그대로 하자는 거잖아요.

DialogKR.Name: 아츠코
DialogKR.Text: 후훗. 사람은 경험의 동물이니까. 거기에 또……

DialogKR.Name: 사오리
DialogKR.Text: 음? 이 정도면 대략적인 방향성은 잡힌 것 같은데?

DialogKR.Name: 사오리
DialogKR.Text: 물론 이제부터 여러 동아리 신청이 들어올지도 모르고, 예산과 타당성에 맞춰 허가나 불허의 판단을 내리기도 해야겠지만…….

DialogKR.Name: 사오리
DialogKR.Text: 그건 그때 가서 상황을 보며 진행하면 될 것 같고…….

DialogKR.Name: 사오리
DialogKR.Text: 뭐라고? 그런 공적인 사항들이 아니라, 내 개인적인 욕심을 말해 줬으면 한다?

DialogKR.Name: 사오리
DialogKR.Text: 그, 그건 곤란하다. 아츠코. 이제 우리는 더 이상 우리 자신만 생각해서는 안 되는 위치이기도 하고…….

DialogKR.Name: 사오리
DialogKR.Text: 그, 그렇다면. 이건 정말 아무래도 좋은 의견이라고 생각하고, 흘려 넘겨도 좋다만……

DialogKR.Name: 사오리
DialogKR.Text: ……우리도, 교복…… 같은 거, 만들어 보면 어떨까 한다…….

DialogKR.Name: 사오리
DialogKR.Text: 예쁘고, 귀여우면 좋을 것 같기도 하고…….

DialogKR.Name: 아츠코
DialogKR.Text: 고마워, 삿 쨩. 그런 말이 듣고 싶었어.

DialogKR.Name: 아츠코
DialogKR.Text: 미안. 이건 조금 더 정리해서 이야기해 줄게.

DialogKR.Name: 아츠코
DialogKR.Text: 응…… 본인도 그걸 아는지, 처음에는 우애앵~ 하고 울었어.

DialogKR.Name: 아츠코
DialogKR.Text: 그리고 다시 정신을 차려서, 정말로 열심히 해 보겠다고 의욕을 불태웠지만.

DialogKR.Name: 아츠코
DialogKR.Text: 히요리가 의욕을 내는 건 좋은 일이니까. 나도 기뻤어.

DialogKR.Name: 마이아
DialogKR.Text: 저, 저도 잘 모르겠지만 그냥 좋네요……. 히요리 씨, 친절하니까요…….

DialogKR.Name: 아츠코
DialogKR.Text: 아, 그리고 <니코메디아 트룹>에도 부탁하고 싶은 일이 있어.

DialogKR.Name: 아츠코
DialogKR.Text: 아리우스의 선도부 역할을 맡아 주었으면 해.

DialogKR.Name: 아츠코
DialogKR.Text: 응. 다른 학교의 치안이나 풍기, 질서를 담당하는, 자치 무력 기관이지.

DialogKR.Name: 아츠코
DialogKR.Text: 이것만큼은 스바루 씨 말고는, 누구에게도 부탁할 수 없다고 생각했어.

DialogKR.Name: 스바루
DialogKR.Text: (인사 관련 사항을 불만 없이 처리할 수 있다는 건, 그 자체로 재능이기도 하고요.)

DialogKR.Name: 스바루
DialogKR.Text: 궁극적으로, 뭘 할 생각인가요? 아츠코 씨.

DialogKR.Name: 스바루
DialogKR.Text: ……그 부분에서는 우리들의 생각이 일치하고 있는 것 같네요.

DialogKR.Name: 아츠코
DialogKR.Text: 응. 아리우스에 남은 학생들이라면, 모두 비슷하지 않을까 해.

DialogKR.Name: 스바루
DialogKR.Text: ………그건 그렇겠죠. 하지만, 할 일이 엄청나게 많지 않을까요?

DialogKR.Name: 아츠코
DialogKR.Text: 그건 알고 있어. 그래서 이번에는 책임을 방기하지 않으려고. 이 말은 이미 했던 거지만.

DialogKR.Name: 아츠코
DialogKR.Text: 솔직히 말하자면, 혼자서는 그다지 자신이 없어. 그래서 도와달라고 말하고 싶은 거야.

DialogKR.Name: 스바루
DialogKR.Text: 손을 잡으면, 다 같이 넘어져 버릴 수도 있을 텐데요.

DialogKR.Name: 아츠코
DialogKR.Text: 아니면 넘어진 사람을 오히려 일으켜 줄 수도 있을 거고.

DialogKR.Name: 아츠코
DialogKR.Text: 미래는 어차피 모르는 거니까, 너무 나쁜 쪽으로만 생각하고 싶지는 않거든.

DialogKR.Name: 아츠코
DialogKR.Text: 그렇게 볼 수도 있겠지만, 나는 차라리 행동주의라고 생각하고 싶어. 아, 행동주의라는 단어의 정의는 사실 따로 있기는 하지만 말이야.

DialogKR.Name: 아츠코
DialogKR.Text: 내 생각일 뿐이지만, 결국 가장 중요한 건 지금 이 순간 행동하는 것이고.

DialogKR.Name: 아츠코
DialogKR.Text: 그렇게 하기 위해서, 미래에 대한 막연한 희망을 가장해 보자는 것이니까.

DialogKR.Name: 스바루
DialogKR.Text: 그런 생각이라면, 저 역시 최선을 다해 힘을 보태도록 하죠.

DialogKR.Name: 스바루
DialogKR.Text: 정말로 무슨 일이 일어나고 무엇이 다가올지, 우리는 알 수 없으니까요.

DialogKR.Name: 스바루
DialogKR.Text: ……모의고사 같은 거 보게 될지, 누가 알았겠냐고요…….

DialogKR.Name: 아츠코
DialogKR.Text: 후훗. 확실히 그 부분은 나도 놀랐어.

DialogKR.Name: 마이아
DialogKR.Text: 그, 그러고 보니……. 트리니티의 그 구호기사단장이라는 분, 말인데요…….

DialogKR.Name: 아츠코
DialogKR.Text: 미네 씨? 그래. 그 이야기도 해야 하겠네.

DialogKR.Name: 마이아
DialogKR.Text: 네……. 듣기로는, 우리에게 구호를 전하러 왔던 그날 이후, 당분간 계속 누워 있었다고 했어서…….

DialogKR.Name: 아츠코
DialogKR.Text: 시험공부를 며칠 동안 제대로 하지 못하기는 했지만, 이번 모의고사 결과에 큰 영향은 없을 것 같다고 해.

DialogKR.Name: 스바루
DialogKR.Text: 그렇군요……. 그 부분은 다행이라고 해야 하겠네요.

DialogKR.Name: 아츠코
DialogKR.Text: 응. 사실 그날, 미네 씨는……. <계시록의 천사> 네 명분의 힘을, 자기 안에 봉인했던 것이나 다름없었거든.

DialogKR.Name: 아츠코
DialogKR.Text: 응. 미네 씨가 천사 네 명을 쓰러트리고, 자기도 의식을 잃었잖아?

DialogKR.Name: 아츠코
DialogKR.Text: 그 때문에 일곱 천사가 전부 조화를 이루며 힘을 개방하는 일도, 일어나지 않을 수 있었던 거였어.

DialogKR.Name: 스바루
DialogKR.Text: 그러면 미네 씨는…… 천사 네 명을 담은 채, 버티고 있었다는 건가요?!

DialogKR.Name: 스바루
DialogKR.Text: 아, 죄송해요. 제가 조금 목소리가 컸네요. 그렇지만……. 그래도…….

DialogKR.Name: 아츠코
DialogKR.Text: 맞아. 그래서 스바루가 마지막 천사로서 격퇴당했을 때, 미네 씨도 거의 동시에 눈을 떴다고 들었어.

DialogKR.Name: 스바루
DialogKR.Text: ……세상에. 하나만 감당해도 거의 의식이 없어질 지경이었는데, 그 사람의 정신력은 도대체 어떻게 된 건가요…….

DialogKR.Name: 아츠코
DialogKR.Text: ……어쩌면 그런 것이 신념이나 올곧음이라는 게 아닐까?

DialogKR.Name: 아츠코
DialogKR.Text: 어떤 상황이 오고, 무엇이 닥치더라도, 그리고 그 모든 비극이 일어난다는 것을 인정하더라도.

DialogKR.Name: 아츠코
DialogKR.Text: 그래도, 계속해서 버티며 나아가는 모습 말이야.

DialogKR.Name: 스바루
DialogKR.Text: 그런데 말이죠. 다 좋은데, 이해가 안 가는 부분이 있는데 말입니다.

DialogKR.Name: 스바루
DialogKR.Text: 왜 사람을 구호하겠다면서, 사람을 엉망으로 만들어버리는 건가요, 그분.

DialogKR.Name: 스바루
DialogKR.Text: 왜 갑자기 가면 쓰고 그래요?! 당신, 그거 쓰면 말 제대로 못 하는 거 아니었어요?!

DialogKR.Name: 스바루
DialogKR.Text: 이제 와서 수화로 뭔가 이야기하려고 해 봤자, 우린 못 알아듣거든요?!?!

DialogKR.Name: 마이아
DialogKR.Text: 여차하면 도망갈 수 있는 구석을 만들어 놓는 것도, 아주 중요한 일이군요!

DialogKR.Name: 스바루
DialogKR.Text: 그런 건 굳이 안 배워도 돼요…….

DialogKR.Name: 스바루
DialogKR.Text: 그렇다고 할까, 그런 상황 자체를 안 만드는 게 좋아요…….

DialogKR.Name: 아츠코
DialogKR.Text: 보는 대로, 일단은 여기만 복구가 완료된 상황이지만.

DialogKR.Name: 아츠코
DialogKR.Text: 하나하나, 새로운 곳으로 바꿔 나가고 싶어.

DialogKR.Name: 미사키
DialogKR.Text: ……뭐, 학교가 좀 사람 사는 데 같아야 다닐 기분이 들 테니까.

DialogKR.Name: 미사키
DialogKR.Text: ………언젠가는 신입생이나 전학생도, 받아야 할 거고 말이지.

DialogKR.Name: 히요리
DialogKR.Text: 그렇지만 우리 학교에 오고 싶어 하는 사람이 있을까요오…….

DialogKR.Name: 사오리
DialogKR.Text: 그…… 우리 학교 특유의, 함부로 이야기하기 힘든 기술들을 배우고 싶다고…….

DialogKR.Name: 히요리
DialogKR.Text: 그, 그건 가능하면 사라지는 편이 좋은 기술들 아닌가요?!?!

DialogKR.Name: 사오리
DialogKR.Text: ……힘을 동경하는 사람은, 언제 어디에서나 있어 왔으니까…….

DialogKR.Name: 미사키
DialogKR.Text: 그 실체가 뭔지 알게 되면, 어차피 바로 도망갈 테니까 걱정할 필요 없어.
[s] "그, 그러고 보니 다들 시험은 잘 봤어?"

DialogKR.Name: 아츠코
DialogKR.Text: 음…… 나는 10등급 중 2등급이었어. 처음 보는 시험 치고는, 나쁘지 않았던 것일지도?

DialogKR.Name: 히요리
DialogKR.Text: 우애애애앵~ 따스한 위로가 더 마음 아픈 거 있죠~

DialogKR.Name: 스바루
DialogKR.Text: 순찰 완료 보고드립니다……. 어라, 선생님 오셨군요?

DialogKR.Name: 마이아
DialogKR.Text: 아, 안녕하세요. 선생님. 아리우스에…… 어서 오세요!

DialogKR.Name: 마이아
DialogKR.Text: 네……? 모의고사 성적이 나왔다길래, 한번 와 보신 거라고요?!

DialogKR.Name: 마이아
DialogKR.Text: 죄송해요, 선생님……. 저, 4등급밖에 못 받았어요……. 으아아앙~
[s] "선생님에게 뭐 할 말 없으신가요, 스바루 학생?"
― [log=스바루]모든 게 꿈이었던 게 아닐까,[wa:900] 생각될 지경이지만…….[/log]

DialogEN.Text: Episode 10;Ecclesia for Those Who Don't Disappear
[log]Mock Exam Day[/log]

DialogEN.Name: Arius Students
DialogEN.Text: Well?

DialogEN.Name: Arius Student A
DialogEN.Text: Hm.

DialogEN.Name: Arius Student A
DialogEN.Text: I don't have anything to back it up...

DialogEN.Name: Arius Student A
DialogEN.Text: ...but I suddenly feel really confident that everything's going to be okay.

DialogEN.Name: Arius Student A
DialogEN.Text: Again, I've done nothing to warrant feeling this way.

DialogEN.Name: Arius Student B
DialogEN.Text: You didn't study at all, did you?

DialogEN.Name: Arius Student C
DialogEN.Text: So I was thinking...

DialogEN.Name: Arius Student D
DialogEN.Text: Um...

DialogEN.Name: Arius Student C
DialogEN.Text: Textbooks are books that are made to teach students well, right?

DialogEN.Name: Arius Student D
DialogEN.Text: Right...

DialogEN.Name: Arius Student C
DialogEN.Text: Then, as far as I can tell, our textbook sucks.

DialogEN.Name: Arius Student C
DialogEN.Text: It didn't teach me anything.

DialogEN.Name: Arius Student D
DialogEN.Text: Wow. I've literally never heard that kind of logic before...

DialogEN.Name: Arius Student D
DialogEN.Text: With that, good luck on the test...

DialogEN.Name: Arius Student C
DialogEN.Text: You too...

DialogEN.Name: Arius Student C
DialogEN.Text: Get exactly one more question wrong than me!

DialogEN.Name: Arius Student D
DialogEN.Text: You totally just cursed me!
[ns] "All right! Did everyone study hard?"

DialogEN.Name: Arius Student A
DialogEN.Text: Ah, Sensei!

DialogEN.Name: Arius Student B
DialogEN.Text: Sensei...

DialogEN.Name: Arius Student B
DialogEN.Text: What should you do when you feel like you're gonna bomb a test?
[s1] "That's just the beginning! You haven't even started yet."
[s2] "Just wait until you walk inside and sit at your desk."
[s3] "Suddenly, everything you studied will start to go blurry..."

DialogEN.Name: Arius Student C
DialogEN.Text: Wow... I feel...a thousand times worse...
[s] "Anyway, do your best, everyone!"

DialogEN.Name: Arius Student D
DialogEN.Text: Okaaay...

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: Hi, Sensei. Nice to see you. You came out here to meet us?

DialogEN.Name: Misaki
DialogEN.Text: You're such a worrywart... Do you seriously think we're going to run away at this point? We went through too much trouble to get here.

DialogEN.Name: Saori
DialogEN.Text: Hm? Is Sensei not here purely to cheer us on?

DialogEN.Name: Hiyori
DialogEN.Text: Oh... I mean, I thought Misaki was just saying that to be Misaki...

DialogEN.Name: Saori
DialogEN.Text: I-I see. I apologize, Misaki.

DialogEN.Name: Misaki
DialogEN.Text: Seriously? I wasn't—

DialogEN.Name: Misaki
DialogEN.Text: *sigh* Whatever.

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: Well then, we should be off, Sensei.

DialogEN.Name: Hiyori
DialogEN.Text: I-I'll do my very best...

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: Hello, Sensei.

DialogEN.Name: Maia
DialogEN.Text: Ah, hi, Sensei... Did you not have to work today?
[s4] "Today, this is my work…"
[s5] "My job is to proctor and cheer!"

DialogEN.Name: Maia
DialogEN.Text: I-I see.

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: Hm? You want to know how I feel about taking the Arius mock exam?

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: Honestly... I can't say the idea sits well with me yet.

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: But all of the Arius kids wanted to try again.

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: And I've decided to put my trust in them.

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: You as well, Sensei.
[s] "Thank you, Subaru."

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: E-Eh? What? Why? Wasn't that uncalled for?!
[s] "Thank you for trusting me."

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: W-Well, that isn't anything to...

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: Huh? You get anxious and unsure when your students don't trust what you're doing?

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: I...wasn't expecting such an honest answer.

DialogEN.Name: Maia
DialogEN.Text: D-Does that mean I'm helping you too, Sensei?!
[s] "Yes, absolutely. Good girl. I'm very proud of you."
I patted Maia on the head.

DialogEN.Name: Maia
DialogEN.Text: Heehee... Heh... That feels nice... Thank you, Sensei.

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: M-Me too...

DialogEN.Name: Maia
DialogEN.Text: Subaru! Let's go! It's already time!

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: Huh? O-Oh...

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: Okay...
[ns] "I wonder if the Trinity exam has started yet..."
(If there's one good thing about being an adult...)
(...It's that I don't have to take mock exams anymore... What a silly thought.)
I spent some time getting work done at a nearby cafe while I waited for the exam to end.

DialogEN.Name: Arius Student A
DialogEN.Text: Ugh... It's really, actually over...

DialogEN.Name: Arius Student B
DialogEN.Text: So? How was it?

DialogEN.Name: Arius Student D
DialogEN.Text: It was a complete disaster...

DialogEN.Name: Arius Student A
DialogEN.Text: H-Hey, they haven't even been graded yet!

DialogEN.Name: Arius Student D
DialogEN.Text: You know...sometimes you just know...

DialogEN.Name: Arius Student B
DialogEN.Text: ...Honestly, same...

DialogEN.Name: Arius Student D
DialogEN.Text: My sister-in-arms...
[ns] "Welcome back, everyone!"

DialogEN.Name: Arius Student A
DialogEN.Text: Sensei...

DialogEN.Name: Arius Student B
DialogEN.Text: *Sob*... Sensei...

DialogEN.Name: Arius Student C
DialogEN.Text: I'm positive I totally bombed the test...!
[s6] "That doesn't matter right now!"
[s7] "We have to uphold the long-held tradition to complete our exams!"

DialogEN.Name: Arius Student D
DialogEN.Text: What's that?

DialogEN.Name: Arius Student A
DialogEN.Text: Like...to celebrate the end of exam season?
[s8] "That's right...the post-exam party!"
[s9] "We'll eat delicious food and have a great time!"
[s10] "It's a tradition that we must never let die out!"

DialogEN.Name: Arius Student B
DialogEN.Text: W-Wow! There are amazing traditions like that?

DialogEN.Name: Arius Student C
DialogEN.Text: Maybe exams aren't so bad after all!

DialogEN.Name: Arius Student D
DialogEN.Text: Wait, wait, wait. Let's not forget how brutal all that studying was THAT quickly.

DialogEN.Name: Arius Student A
DialogEN.Text: But it's done with, isn't it?

DialogEN.Name: Arius Student A
DialogEN.Text: Once the pain's over, it's not pain anymore!

DialogEN.Name: Arius Student D
DialogEN.Text: That's the Arius way!

DialogEN.Name: Arius Student B
DialogEN.Text: Right!

DialogEN.Name: Arius Student B
DialogEN.Text: Can you buy us something delicious, please, Sensei?
[s11] "Invite everyone! Don't worry about a thing!"
[s12] "...Although, please keep my poor wallet in mind, at least..."

DialogEN.Name: Arius Students
DialogEN.Text: Okay!
And just like that...
...their very first exam, and after-party, came to a peaceful, happy close.

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: Hello, Subaru, Maia. Please, sit.

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: Hello, Atsuko.

DialogEN.Name: Maia
DialogEN.Text: U-Um... Hello, P-Princess Atsuko...

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: Fufu. I'm not a princess anymore, so there's no need for the title.

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: Didn't we agree to be friendly with each other?

DialogEN.Name: Maia
DialogEN.Text: W-We did! It's just... Okay... *inhale*

DialogEN.Name: Maia
DialogEN.Text: A-Atsuko. Hello, Atsuko.

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: Thank you. I appreciate it.

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: So, what did you want to talk about, Atsuko?

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: Hm... The exam went well, right? And I heard that this is a common post-exam activity in the outside world.

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: First, let's fill our stomachs. This cafe's pecan pie is supposedly very famous.

DialogEN.Name: Maia
DialogEN.Text: O-Okay... Thank you very much...

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: So, how did both of you feel about the exam? I think I answered everything to the best of my ability.

DialogEN.Name: Maia
DialogEN.Text: I answered everything I knew as well!

DialogEN.Name: Maia
DialogEN.Text: But, to be honest with you, there was a lot more I didn't know than I did.

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: What about you, Subaru?

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: ...It was my first time taking a mock exam, and the third-year questions felt a bit heavy for me. That's all.

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: Fufu. Since it's just a mock exam, it's only meant to be a...personal benchmark, of sorts.

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: There aren't any punishments for a mock exam either, so it doesn't matter what your results are.

DialogEN.Name: Maia
DialogEN.Text: Huh...? Do real exams...have punishments?!

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: Hm... If you do too poorly, you'll need to take supplemental classes.

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: And if your grades don't improve, you could be held back a year, or be barred from graduating.

DialogEN.Name: Maia
DialogEN.Text: Ah... So that's what "punishments" are...

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: ...Yes.

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: These are the ways in a much kinder world.

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: What are your plans for the Squad from here on out, Atsuko?

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: I assumed you would be curious.

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: The Arius Squad intends to address the responsibilities it's been neglecting until now.

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: ...And how does it plan on doing that?

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: Until the next Arius student council is officially and fairly elected, the Arius Squad intends to function as an acting student council.

DialogEN.Name: Maia
DialogEN.Text: The Arius Squad...will act as the Arius student council? But then... Then...

DialogEN.Name: Maia
DialogEN.Text: That would make our school...just like other schools...

DialogEN.Name: Maia
DialogEN.Text: Wouldn't that mean that, after hundreds and hundreds of years, the Arius Satellite School is going to get back to normal?

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: I'll do all I can to ensure that happens.

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: Yes. I'll have to, as Arius' acting student council president.

DialogEN.Name: Maia
DialogEN.Text: Student council president?!?!

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: Easy, easy. You're getting a little loud, Maia.

DialogEN.Name: Maia
DialogEN.Text: A-Ah. Sorry.

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: Objectively, based on what few traditions Arius still has, it couldn't be anyone but you.

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: Okay. What does everyone else intend on doing?

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: Misaki will be treasurer.

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: She complained, of course. "You really want to work me to the bone, don't you? Fine, if you really have no one better."

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: In Misaki-speak, that means, "I'm doing it anyway, so I might as well do my best."

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: What on earth is "Misaki-speak"...?

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: Well... It's a language where you simply flip about half of what she says. Don't say that to her face, though. She'll be quite enraged with you.

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: *sigh*...

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: And Saori will be vice president, and a general manager as well.

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: I can follow the logic.

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: For management, she proposed this policy: Everyone should work part-time jobs whenever they are able.

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: What? Why?!

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: She said it's because you'll learn about society quickly, earn some pocket money, and help with the Arius rebuilding efforts.

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: Since scams are a concern, she's directed everyone to get contracts approved by her before they sign anything. She rather sheepishly explained that she's undergone a lot of trial and error in that field.

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: ...So she's just making everyone follow her blueprint.

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: Fufu. People learn best from experience, after all. Also...

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: "Also"?

DialogEN.Name: Saori
DialogEN.Text: Hm? We're starting to get the groundwork laid down.

DialogEN.Name: Saori
DialogEN.Text: If we start getting club applications, we'll need to evaluate them based on budget and feasibility...

DialogEN.Name: Saori
DialogEN.Text: It'll have to be on a case by case basis, when the time comes.

DialogEN.Name: Saori
DialogEN.Text: Hm? Less logistics, more of my personal wishes?

DialogEN.Name: Saori
DialogEN.Text: I-I couldn't, Atsuko. We're not in a position to be putting ourselves, or our wants, first anymore.

DialogEN.Name: Saori
DialogEN.Text: It's a request from my student council president...?

DialogEN.Name: Saori
DialogEN.Text: W-Well... There's little justification for them, so you may ignore this thought entirely.

DialogEN.Name: Saori
DialogEN.Text: It crossed my mind... What if we...made ourselves uniforms...?

DialogEN.Name: Saori
DialogEN.Text: Something pretty, and cute.

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: Thank you, Sao-Sao. That's exactly what I wanted to hear.

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: Sorry. I'll elaborate when the time is right.

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: Huh? Sure. Fine by me.

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: And Hiyori...

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: ...Hiyori is...

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: ...our secretary?

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: So a secretary, also acting as a record keeper. That's...

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: Yeah... She cried quite a bit when she first realized...

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: Then, she pulled herself together and got fired up about doing her best.

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: Hiyori always does great things when she's motivated to, so I was very happy.

DialogEN.Name: Maia
DialogEN.Text: I-I don't really know why, but that makes me happy too... Hiyori's just really kind...

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: Well... As long as it makes you happy.

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: Oh, and there's something I want to ask of Nicomedia's Troop as well.

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: ...Us? What is it?

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: I'd like you to take on the role of Arius's disciplinary team.

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: Disciplinary...team?

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: Yeah, an autonomous force in charge of public order, morals, and discipline.

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: For this, I really don't think I can ask anyone but you, Subaru.

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: ...And if I say no?

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: Are you really gonna be that way?

DialogEN.Name: Maia
DialogEN.Text: S-Subaru...?

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: *sigh*

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: You've always been a crafty one, Atsuko.

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: Have I? I suppose I AM the student council president. Even if just for now.

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: Yeah, yeah. Exactly as you should.

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: (Handling personnel matters this smoothly is a talent in itself.)

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: So what's your big plan, Atsuko?

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: I want to turn Arius into a wonderful school.

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: ...Then we're on the same page there.

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: Yeah. I figure any student from Arius will say the same.

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: ...You're not wrong. There's an absurd amount of work to do, though, isn't there?

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: I know. I won't run away again. I'll assert that as many times as you need.

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: Are you confident in your abilities?

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: To be frank, no. I'm not. That's why I need help.

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: Joining hands just means it's easier for one person to pull down the other.

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: Or it's easier to pull each other back up if one of us falls.

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: There's no way of knowing the future, so I don't want to dwell on worst-case scenarios.

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: Isn't that just unfounded optimism?

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: You could see it that way, but I'd rather call it activism. Ah, I know the word has its own definition, strictly speaking.

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: I've been using it to convey that what matters is to take action in the here and now, in the moment I am currently standing in.

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: And I don't believe we can do that without at least pretending we harbor some vague, hazy hope for our future.

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: Together, if we can.

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: Understood.

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: If that's how you feel, then I'll do my best to support you.

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: We really don't know what'll happen next, or what's coming our way.

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: I mean, who would've thought we'd end up taking some mock exam...?

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: Fufu. I admit, even I was caught off guard by that.

DialogEN.Name: Maia
DialogEN.Text: C-Come to think of it.....about that Remedial Knights captain from Trinity...

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: Mine? Right. We should talk about her too.

DialogEN.Name: Maia
DialogEN.Text: Yes... I heard she was bedridden for a while, after the incident in Arius.

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: She was. However...

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: There's nothing to worry about. She's recovered completely.

DialogEN.Name: Maia
DialogEN.Text: Really?! That's great to hear!

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: She was unable to study for a few days, but it sounds like it won't have much impact on her mock exam results.

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: I see... I guess that's a relief, at least.

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: Yeah. The truth is, that day Mine essentially sealed the power of the four Angels of Revelation inside herself.

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: What? That's what actually happened?!

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: Yes. Just before she passed out, she defeated four of the angels, if you recall.

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: Her actions stymied the seven angels' only chance to harmonize and unleash their full power.

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: Mine...endured the power of all four angels?! By sheer will?!

DialogEN.Name: Maia
DialogEN.Text: Wh-What's wrong, Subaru...?

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: Ah, no, I'm sorry. I didn't mean to raise my voice. I was just so...

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: It would seem that Mine awoke at almost the exact moment you were defeated as the final angel.

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: ...I could barely handle just one. Her mentality and strength are out of this world.

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: ...Maybe that's what you call conviction, or integrity.

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: No matter what happens, no matter what comes at her, even knowing that it may end in tragedy...

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: ...she endures and presses forward regardless.

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: That part of her...really is incredible.

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: It is...

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: That said, there's one thing I just can't wrap my head around.

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: What is it?

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: If she's trying to help people, why does she leave them in such a wreck?

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: A-Atsuko?

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: You're pulling out your mask? Seriously?! No one can hear you when you wear that thing!

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: (Flick, flick, fwoosh.)

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: I don't know sign language! And you know that!

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: Are you running away again, Hakari Atsuko?!

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: ...But she still made sure to pay in advance...

DialogEN.Name: Maia
DialogEN.Text: Subaru, I just realized something!

DialogEN.Name: Maia
DialogEN.Text: Leaving yourself an escape route, in case of emergency, is super important!

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: That's not something you should try to learn...

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: Better yet, just learn to not put yourself in a situation where you would need one.

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: Oh, Sensei. Welcome.
[s13] "Hi, Atsuko. Hi, everyone!"
[s14] "How's the restoration work going?"

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: As you can see, this is currently the only place that's been fully restored.

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: This is the starting point. From here on outwards...

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: ...we want to create a new Arius, one building at a time.

DialogEN.Name: Misaki
DialogEN.Text: I mean, no one wants to go to a school that looks abandoned.

DialogEN.Name: Misaki
DialogEN.Text: ...And someday we'll have to accept new students and transfers again.

DialogEN.Name: Hiyori
DialogEN.Text: Do you really think...anyone would really want to come here?

DialogEN.Name: Saori
DialogEN.Text: Apparently... Some people are interested.

DialogEN.Name: Saori
DialogEN.Text: They're interested in the...particular set of skills that is most widely associated with our school.

DialogEN.Name: Hiyori
DialogEN.Text: Sh-Shouldn't we let that kind of stuff just fade into nothingness?!

DialogEN.Name: Saori
DialogEN.Text: ...No matter when or where, there'll always be people who idolize power.

DialogEN.Name: Misaki
DialogEN.Text: People like those won't last long here, anyways.
[s] "That reminds me, how did everyone do on the exam?"

DialogEN.Name: Atsuko
DialogEN.Text: Let me think... Out of ten ranks, I was number two. For my first try at taking a test, I believe that should be acceptable?

DialogEN.Name: Misaki
DialogEN.Text: ...Rank three.

DialogEN.Name: Misaki
DialogEN.Text: ...Literature really is hopelessly nonlinear...

DialogEN.Name: Hiyori
DialogEN.Text: I was rank four... Waaah...
[s15] "It's okay, Hiyori! It's okay!"
[s16] "Rank four's still good! Really good!"

DialogEN.Name: Hiyori
DialogEN.Text: Waaah...! Kindness can come across as pity at times like these!
[s] "You can just do better next time!!"

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: Patrol report complete... Oh, Sensei, you're here?

DialogEN.Name: Maia
DialogEN.Text: Ah, hello, Sensei. Welcome to Arius!

DialogEN.Name: Maia
DialogEN.Text: M-More importantly, what brings you here?

DialogEN.Name: Maia
DialogEN.Text: Huh...? You came because you heard the mock exam results were out?!

DialogEN.Name: Maia
DialogEN.Text: I'm sorry, Sensei... I only got rank four... Uwaaah...

DialogEN.Name: Hiyori
DialogEN.Text: Rank four...? You too?

DialogEN.Name: Maia
DialogEN.Text: H-Hiyori, you too?

DialogEN.Name: Hiyori
DialogEN.Text: That would mean we're...rank four buddies!

DialogEN.Name: Maia
DialogEN.Text: Yeah! Buddies!

DialogEN.Name: Hiyori
DialogEN.Text: We'll try even harder next time!

DialogEN.Name: Maia
DialogEN.Text: Yeah! I'll put in double the work!

DialogEN.Name: Hiyori & Maia
DialogEN.Text: UWAAAHHH!
[ns] "By the way."

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: Y-Yes...?
[s] "You don't have anything you want to tell me, Subaru?"

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: I mean, I'm sure that's why you came all this way.
[ns] "You placed fifth."

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: ...Yes.
[s] "How about we put more time into studying from here on out?"

DialogEN.Name: Subaru
DialogEN.Text: ...Okaaay...
[wa:1850]― [log=스바루]Seriously, [wa:2040]so much [wa:620]has happened.[/log]
[wa:560]― [log=스바루]Looking back,[/log]
― [log=스바루]it almost feels like [wa:900]it was all just a dream...[/log]
[wa:250]― [log=스바루]I wanted to [wa:1520]thank you,[/log]
― [log=스바루]for all that [wa:1050]you've done.[wa:80] [/log]
[wa:350]― [log=스바루]That, at least, [wa:1820]I can promise is sincere.[/log]

DialogEN.Name: Saori
DialogEN.Text: Hm? You mean my grades?

DialogEN.Name: Saori
DialogEN.Text: Hm...

DialogEN.Name: Saori
DialogEN.Text: This might sound a bit like I'm bragging, but...

DialogEN.Name: Saori
DialogEN.Text: It's all thanks to you, regardless, Sensei.

DialogEN.Name: Saori
DialogEN.Text: I placed first.

DialogEN.Name: Saori
DialogEN.Text: Thank you, Sensei.

DialogEN.Name: Saori
DialogEN.Text: You really are...the greatest thing that has happened to my life.

DialogTH.Text: ตอนที่ 10;เอคลีเซีย แด่เรื่องราวที่ไม่เคยเลือนหาย
